description: List the Specification Uploads in a Project

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The ID of the project to upload to

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified status.

parameters.name: filters[specification_set_id]
parameters.description: Return items with the specified set ID.

id.description: Unique identifier for the specification upload.

issued_date.description: Date the specifications were issued by the design team. Null if not provided.

received_date.description: Date the specifications were received. Null if not provided.

status.description: Processing status of the specification upload.

spec_format.description: Specification format applied to the upload.

specification_set_id.description: ID of the specification set this upload belongs to.

401.description: Company or project is not valid, user is not an active contact, company does not have an ERP connection
